content:
And in turn the lord of men Agamemnon addressed him:
"I rejoice, son of Laertes, having heard your speech;
for you have gone through and recounted everything fittingly.
These things I am willing to swear, and my heart bids me,
nor will I swear falsely before the god. But let Achilles
remain there meanwhile, though he is eager for war;
and remain, all the rest of you, gathered together, until the gifts
come from my hut and we cut faithful oaths.
And to you yourself I give this charge and command:
choosing out young men, the noblest of all the Achaeans,
to bring the gifts from my ship, all that yesterday
we promised to give Achilles, and to bring the women.
And let Talthybius quickly, throughout the wide camp of the Achaeans,
prepare a boar for me to sacrifice to Zeus and to Helios."
